findings: Repository contains 25 knowledge base entries (KB-0001 through KB-0025), with KB-0015/16/17 being very large (33-48KB) covering coordination features, bug analysis, and stress tests
Two prototype communication systems exist: Proto A (agent_comm, production) and Proto B (agent_comm_b, archived) - Proto A won the comparison
44 data source definitions (SRC-0001 through SRC-0044) covering academic, news, government, financial, weather, developer, and AI/ML APIs
3 compiled Go binaries (fast_cache, fast_search, fast_validate) totaling ~9.4MB provide high-speed storage operations
Coordination system is the largest module with hub-and-spoke architecture, direct channels, help protocol, work stealing, pipeline chaining, and scratchpad primitives
benchmark_results.json at 2.2MB is the single largest file in the repository
16 SOPs cover team operations from commander launch to prompt engineering to infrastructure audits
21 team session logs track the complete history of iterative development across teams TEAM-0001 through TEAM-0025
3 D3.js visualization scripts (viz_data_flow, viz_kb_graph, viz_team_hierarchy) plus a top-level visualizer.html provide interactive repo exploration
Data gathering module has 12 method implementations covering academic, news, code, and hybrid search strategies with caching and deduplication
Market research module includes 4 analysis methods (fundamental, technical, sentiment, quantitative) plus 8 AI quant technique categories
5 root-level team logs (TEAM-0015 through TEAM-0019) exist outside sessions/ directory - potential organizational inconsistency
No TEAM-0011 session log exists - gap in team numbering sequence
All Python code uses stdlib only (no external dependencies) except sonnet-research-api/client.py which requires the anthropic SDK
